caption:
For the nights hardship feels too heavy, the dua of Ayyub

Ayyub called on his Lord in his adversity and named Him the Most Merciful of those who show mercy. Allah responded, relieved his adversity, and restored his family.

Surah Al-Anbiyaa 21:83-84

Send this to someone who is going through a hard time

#duaofayyub #hardtimes #prophetstories #quranreels

Recitation: Mohamed Siddiq Al-Minshawi
alt_text: And [remember] Job, when he cried out to his Lord, “I have been struck by adversity, and You are the Most Merciful of those who show mercy.” So We responded to him and relieved his adversity, and We restored to him his family, twice as many, as a mercy from Us and as a reminder for Our worshipers (Surah Al-Anbiyaa 21:83-84)
